name: 100x-bakeoff
description: Use for /100x-bakeoff, or when the owner asks whether 100x makes better prototypes than the same agent without it: 'does 100x help', 'run the bake-off', 'compare with and without the skill'. Runs a blind skill-off against skill-on comparison from the protocol and answers with one honest paragraph and a number. It tests the skill and builds no prototype. A project's own review is 100x-judge.
